QuestInfo.name: Over the Castle Walls (1)
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1300003##k wants to you to deliver a message to #p1300005# regarding the Castle Invasion plan.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p1300003##k told you that the Mushroom Kingdom is too low on resources to launch a counter-offensive. The Secretary of Defense is looking for a sneakier way to resolve the situation.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 1,600\nCan proceed to the Over the Castle Walls (2) quest\n

0.0: I keep hearing your name, adventurer. Our people speak of your great prowess and clever problem-solving skills. I think you are just the person we need on our side!

yes.0: It is time we prepare ourselves! I will deliver this wonderful news to #p1300005# and return when I've finished.

no.0: Oh, are you the wrong human? You all look alike to me, but I was sure the person they speak of matched your description.

1.0: #p1300005# and his soldiers have reported a lack of supplies for their offensive maneuvers. I am remiss to ask for outside help, but our kingdom needs you.

yes.0: The problem now is to figure out how to enter the castle.
